title: Codex CLI Agent on AWS Lambda MicroVMs
description: Deploy an AWS Lambda MicroVM with the OpenAI Codex CLI, powered by Amazon Bedrock and reachable through an interactive shell.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an AWS Lambda MicroVM with the Codex CLI installed into the image. The MicroVM is launched with the SHELL_INGRESS network connector, so you connect over an interactive shell and run codex directly inside the isolated Firecracker VM.

Codex uses its built-in amazon-bedrock model provider, so inference runs on Amazon Bedrock with credentials supplied at runtime by the MicroVM execution role. No API keys are stored in the image. Codex is also connected to the AWS MCP Server from the Agent Toolkit for AWS through the MCP Proxy for AWS, which signs requests with the same execution-role credentials, so it can make live AWS API calls, search AWS documentation, and retrieve AWS skills. Access to AWS is read-only, enforced by IAM.

The image is Region-agnostic: the model, MCP endpoint, and Region are rendered into the Codex configuration at runtime from the MicroVM environment. The MicroVM suspends when idle, resumes on demand, and has a hard maximum lifetime, so treat it as disposable.
See the README in the GitHub repository for deployment steps, design notes, and troubleshooting.
